label: GO-only; strongest after an unrewarded rare a1 trial that followed a reward
short_terms: (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S2 u") ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S2 u") * (tv("reward", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S1 r") * belief
terms: (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S2 u") ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S2 u") * (tv("reward", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S2 u") * (tv("action", -2) == 2) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S2 u") * belief_lo ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S1 r") * belief ;; (phase == GO) * np.clip(belief_lo, 0, None) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S1 r") * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_action == 1) * (prev_reward == 1) * (ep_trial > 10)
explanation: Active only at GO (zero at D1/D2). Magnitude is largest after the previous trial was a1 -> rare S2 unrewarded (the model-based stay-with-a1 case), and much larger still when the trial before that was rewarded. It is moderate after a1 -> S1 rewarded, scaled by the observer belief that S1 is good. All other previous-trial patterns sit below the timing baseline. Activation decays over runs of consecutive rewarded a1-S1 trials. Belief deciles track it monotonically (high P(S1 good) raises it), but once the last-trial pattern is in the model, belief adds little. The free fit adds a negative a2-two-back modifier, a boost for a1 S1 r preceded by no reward, and a late-episode reduction, for about +0.03 R^2. Observed cues fall short of the policy-decile reference (0.36), so part of the graded magnitude follows the model's internal commitment to a1 more than any simple history term.
